name: modkit
description: An agent that writes and edits software at runtime. Rung 1: an Obsidian plugin that mods Obsidian plugins.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@modkit/types && npm run build --workspace=modkit-plugin && npm run build --workspace=@modkit/daemon
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@modkit/types && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:scripts
